# UX & Visual-Fidelity Checklist: Administrator Dashboard

**Purpose**: Lightweight author self-check of UX/visual-fidelity requirement quality in spec.md
before proceeding to `/speckit-tasks` — are the requirements complete, unambiguous, and
consistent enough to implement against `docs/ui/dashboard.png` without guesswork?
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on
feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is
satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the visual-encoding rules for trend direction (e.g., color/icon per up, down,
  or flat) specified anywhere, or fully deferred to the screenshot? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the visual-encoding rules for container status (color/style distinguishing "In
  Warehouse" from "Checked Out") specified, or fully deferred to the screenshot? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a fallback avatar/initials requirement documented for a signed-in user whose
  name data is incomplete (e.g., missing last name)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are hover-state requirements documented for interactive elements (nav items, table
  rows, buttons), separate from the keyboard-focus requirement in FR-021? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is there a requirement covering minimum/target viewport widths (or breakpoint
  ranges) for "tablet" and "mobile," or are those terms left to implementer judgment?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "visually indicated as the current/active page" (FR-005) tied to any specific,
  checkable visual property, or is it left fully open-ended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "trend information relative to a prior period" (FR-009) clear about which prior
  period applies to each metric (e.g., is "Hours This Week" compared to last week or last
  month)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the search field's matching rules (which columns are searched, case-sensitivity,
  partial vs. exact match) specified in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "truncate or wrap without breaking the row layout" specific enough to know which
  behavior (truncate vs. wrap) applies to which column, or could two implementers reasonably
  disagree? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the time-of-day boundaries for "morning," "afternoon," and "evening" greetings
  defined, or left to implementer judgment? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "row-level actions where appropriate" (FR-016) specific about which actions
  apply to which container status, or is the set of actions left undefined? [Ambiguity, Spec
  §FR-016]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the summary-card requirements (FR-008/FR-009) and the reference screenshot agree
  on which comparison period each card's trend uses, with no contradiction between the generic
  "prior period" wording and the screenshot's literal "vs last month" labels? [Consistency, Spec
  §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK013 Are placeholder-page requirements (FR-006) consistent about whether those pages need
  any shell/visual treatment beyond "placeholder," or could Timesheets/Containers/Drivers/
  Reports/Settings each end up styled inconsistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are loading-state requirements defined for the dashboard's first paint (before mock
  data is available to render), or does the spec only address post-load empty/zero states?
  [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for a container search that matches a very large number of
  rows (as opposed to zero), e.g., whether results are still bounded to a preview size?
  [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for how the trend indicator should render when
  `trendPercent` is exactly zero ("flat"), distinct from up/down styling? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements (UX-bearing)

- [ ] CHK017 Can "remains fully usable and legible" (FR-020) and "no overlapping content, no
  horizontal scrolling" (SC-004) be objectively verified without further quantification (e.g.,
  specific viewport widths to test at)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Are visible-focus-indicator requirements (SC-006) specific enough to be checked
  objectively (e.g., must the indicator be visually distinct from the screenshot's non-focused
  state), or is "visible" left to interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Since `docs/ui/dashboard.png` is desktop-only, is there a documented assumption or
  requirement for how tablet/mobile layout decisions should be validated without an equivalent
  reference screenshot? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the requirements state whether the other `docs/ui/` screenshots (containers.png,
  drivers.png, timesheets.png) apply to this feature's placeholder pages, or are they explicitly
  out of scope for this feature's placeholders? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer
  evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by
  `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
